triviaQuestion: Which superconducting metal powers quantum computer circuits?

hints.title: THE MINECART
hints.text: The old mine's machines still work. A minecart rolls away from you when you walk into it, to the end of its line, and flattens every creature in its way. A snake sleeps in the tunnel to the east, the only way on.
hints.task: Go round by the gallery below, get behind the cart and push it east. Pushed from this side it rolls west into the dead end, and you can no longer get behind it.

hints.title: RIDING A CART
hints.text: A cart also carries you. Step down onto it from above, then press ← or →: it rolls to the end of its line, through water and even through lava, and you ride unharmed. Press ↑ to hop out.
hints.task: Board the cart under the end of this gallery, ride east over the lava and hop out at the far end.

hints.title: RUNAWAY CART
hints.text: On the line below, a runaway cart rolls from end to end without stopping. To stand in its way, or to step in front of it, is fatal. Your way on is a shaft in the floor of the line, five tiles to the west.
hints.task: Wait in the niche above the line. When the cart has gone to the far west end, run west along the line and drop into the shaft.

hints.title: POWDER BARREL
hints.text: A powder barrel rolls away from you when you walk into it, and explodes against the first thing it hits. Its blast breaks ice and earth, not rock. In the tunnel below stands one barrel, and an ice wall closes the tunnel's east end.
hints.task: Two holes in this floor lead down. Take the one that lets you push the barrel east, into the ice.

hints.title: SHAFT LIFT
hints.text: An old lift runs up and down the shaft ahead without stopping, and crushes whatever it meets. Your way on leaves the shaft two tiles further down, to the west.
hints.task: Wait here until the lift has passed you and is near the top of the shaft. Then step in, go down two tiles and step out to the west.

hints.title: SPIDER NEST
hints.text: The lump in the tunnel ahead is a spider nest. It blocks the way, and every few seconds it hatches a spider into any open tunnel beside it: look into the pocket beneath it. Walled in by earth and rock it is harmless. Only a blast destroys a nest, and the blast kills the spiders around it too.
hints.task: Dig away the earth in front of the nest, lay the stick there at once (key 1) and step back two tiles.

hints.title: THE LOGIC DOOR
hints.text: A logic door opens only to the right answer. The question is written on the wall, and each pad on the floor carries an element. A wrong pad costs 30 seconds on the clock.
hints.task: Take the niobium and read its card. Then read the question and step on the pad of the element that answers it.

hints.title: MACHINES MASTERED
hints.text: Carts, barrels, lifts, nests and logic doors: you have worked every one of them. One lesson is left: the survival kit for the deepest mines. Take the exit!
